summary: Signal Stage is a walkable 3D motion-graphics stage whose multiplayer roll launches a synchronized, seeded music trip. A shared director maps selected audio onto the canonical show clock, drives shaders and camera, and deals vision beings into the view only for their slots.
places: places/main/config.yaml (main, 3D) - black-void stage configuration, spawn/environment and place-wide scripts/look-trip.js post-processing.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - field/eye/serpents composition and scripts/stage.js; field origin and portal at (0,15,-34).
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene and x0z-3.scene - sun-eye, tunnel along -Z, chamber and far tunnel-knot stage pieces.
places/main/cells/x0y2z0.scene through x0y16z0.scene - high-altitude vision-home grid; director builds beings only when dealt or held.
places/main/cells/objects.scene - three companion-worm meshes attached to the camera for the shared cinematic view.
places/main/cells/ - 25 scene cells around the main composition; x0y15z0 and x0y16z0 belong to the former being-home area.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer services, player/camera templates, movement and cine/ownSong actions, own-track buyable, arrival, lighting, HUD and nametag.
templates/player.js#player composes humanoid-locomotion.js with scripts/player.js; templates/camera.js#camera runs scripts/camera.js.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - scripts/stage.js synchronizes track/audio and distributes roll/deal parameters.
scripts/ui.js - viewer-local ROLL/CUT and cinematic status HUD, track name/BPM, own-song selection/upload UI; cinema bars avoid mobile controls/chrome and hide on small screens.
places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look installs scripts/look-trip.js as full-screen post-processing.
scripts/buyables/own-track.js - purchase callback turns the buyer's uploaded and measured song into the room's next synchronized roll.
shared: scripts/lib/cine.js - CPU score clock, track-time lookup, section lookup and seeded camera path; used by player, camera, HUD and stage.
scripts/lib/deck.js - cached deterministic per-seed scene-deck deal and track-to-scene-time mapping; used by cine.js and stage.js.
scripts/lib/visions.js - registry of 36 beings, all built/dealable, cached seeded slot deal, timing/shots and energy lookup; used by cine.js and stage.js.
scripts/lib/data/beings.yml - per-being stage rows: geometry/material stems, params, layer suffixes and home depth; stage.js builds a dealt or held being.
scripts/lib/tracks.js - built-in tracks plus normalized paid own-track, seed selection, piecewise track/canonical clock mapping, shader params and track energy; used by cine.js, stage.js and ui.js.

scripts/lib/data/score.yml and shots.yml - canonical sections, layers, lens, maths, deck and authored camera keys; energy.yml holds canonical track data and vision slots; data/tracks/*.yml holds measured alternate-track timing.

scripts/lib/trip.js and field-lib.js, eye-lib.js, tunnel-lib.js, chamber-lib.js/chamber-fx.js, sun-lib.js, serpents-data.js/serpents-curve.js - shared shader clocks/primitives and family placement, spatial, timing and color helpers.
notableExports: scripts/player.js exports onInput, update; scripts/camera.js exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/stage.js exports update; scripts/look-trip.js exports look; scripts/ui.js exports default, pickSong.
scripts/lib/cine.js exports CINE, cineTime, trackTime, sectionAt, rollRnd, cameraAt, beatEnv; scripts/lib/deck.js exports dealDeck, sceneTime.

scripts/lib/tracks.js exports TRACKS, trackFor, toCanon, trackParams, IDENTITY, trackEnergyAt, ownTrack, trackOf, CANON; scripts/lib/visions.js exports BEINGS, dealVisions, visionAt, visionShot, energyAt.
scripts/lib/trip.js exports KICK_RUNS, SEC, BPS, tripClock, win, pal, stripes, HUE, shown, lens, bendUv, visionShown and shared vision-shader primitives.
scripts/field-lib.js exports RADIUS, growR, riseR, resetR, endFade, backOut, base, hot, FAMILY, family, colours, breath, seamHold, held.
scripts/tunnel-lib.js exports Z0, FEET, BOUNDS, tun, inside, camDepth, v3, BLUE, base, hot, GRAPH, mirAng; tunnel-core.js, tunnel-gates.js and tunnel-ribs.js export material.
Vision *-geo modules export geometry/collider (some spine/ring constants); *-mat modules export material; worm geo/material pairs provide animated depth-winding bodies.
ownership: scripts/player.js - local movement intent/velocity and viewer body's state.ownSong upload metadata; ordinary cine input writes shared world.state.cine.
scripts/buyables/own-track.js - successful purchase writes shared world.state.cine={start,by,seed,track,who}; emits room-wide purchase flash and sound.

scripts/stage.js on #director - shared audio session, roll parameter propagation to trip-tagged materials/look, vision visibility/camera attachment, dynamic being spawn/strike, and bench visionTest(s) holds.
scripts/camera.js / templates/camera.js - viewer-local camera pose/FOV and seeded authored shot path/move.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js owns avatar gait/sit state; scripts/ui.js owns viewer-local HUD/song-selection status; ui/nametag.js owns viewer-local name presentation.
Place/world configs own environment and services; scripts/lib/visions.js owns the being registry and deterministic deal cache.
flows: P/Y cine action or HUD sendAction('cine') → scripts/player.js onInput → world.state.cine={start: now+300ms,by,seed} or null; non-buyers cannot cut an active paid-song roll, while its buyer can.
scripts/ui.js file picker → browser decodes/measures audio, uploads it and sends ownSong data → scripts/player.js validates URL, stores self.state.ownSong and proposes an own-track purchase.

world.config.yaml buyables.own-track → scripts/buyables/own-track.js onPurchase reads buyer.state.ownSong → shared world.state.cine with track metadata, buyer and scheduled start; emits room-wide purchase flash and sound.
world.state.cine → scripts/ui.js render → viewer-local ROLL/CUT and rolling progress/section label, selected track name/BPM and buyer attribution.

world.state.cine → scripts/lib/tracks.js trackOf/ownTrack or trackFor → scripts/lib/cine.js maps track time to canonical show seconds; stage.js plays selected shared audio and clears/stages the next roll.
tracks.js maps source track time through vision-window anchors to canonical time → cine.js camera/deck timing and trip.js shader scene timing; track BPM/beat remain source-track values.
Track bar-energy data → tracks.js kick runs converted to canonical time → stage.js supplies k0/k1; trackParams supplies tdur, ta1..ta4, fb and bps to trip-tagged materials/look.
stage.js → trip-tagged material/look params t0/on/seed, track-clock params, kick bounds and dealt scene mappings; look also receives current vision slot v0/v1 and focus depth vd.
stage.js + vision-<id> tags → beings.yml rows spawn each dealt being's geometry/material layers; assembly attaches to camera at depth 74 with layer offsets, then stage destroys it after its slot.
cine.js cameraAt → scripts/camera.js viewer camera; dealt beings and companion worms join camera view rather than replacing it with separate vision shots; stage computes shot-dependent fit scale.

trip.js tripClock/shown/lens/mask helpers → field, eye, serpents, tunnel, chamber, visions and look-trip shader timing/cutouts; shown() gives each layer's 14 radius bands a seeded shuffled arrival order.

world.state.visionTests[being]={at,seed} (and legacy visionTest={being,at,seed}) → stage.js holds multiple beings independently at home, preserves test clocks and skips roll writes for held vision materials/layers.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/field-* - mandala, stalks, orbs and glyph/cartouche field layers share field-lib.js placement/timing; motifs vary, with seam holds on the mandala.
scripts/eye-* - iris, pupil, rays, lids, beads and knot make the portal; eye-lib.js shares eye math and iris geometry is reused for pupil with different parameters; iris uses a seam hold.

scripts/serpents-* - co-located layers build striped/scaled bodies, arches, beads, cones, knots, rose beads and totem; serpents-lib.js/serpents-curve.js share appearance and spine/frame calculations; cones join the seam hold.
scripts/tunnel-* - wall, core, dust, gates, ribs and knot share geometry kinds and tunnel-lib.js spatial/color helpers; materials vary motif and seeded palette; wall holds at scene seams.
scripts/chamber-* - room, circuit, hands, hex, Lissajous, solids and bilateral mask share chamber shader helpers and scored cutouts; room uses a seam hold.
scripts/sun-disc.js, sun-drips.js and sun-halo.js - sun-eye layers share sun-lib.js but vary disc, hanging-drip and depth-halo imagery; disc uses a seam hold.
scripts/vision-*-geo.js / -mat.js - all 36 registered beings are built and dealable; vision materials draw each being's motifs in parameterized world/ring/being/veil layers.
Vision worm geo/material pairs plus scripts/companion-worm-geo.js - unit-tube geometry bent by shader paths; per-being materials vary appearance, geo resolution scales by ctx.lod.
migrationNotes: world.state.cine is the synchronized start/cut source; ordinary starts are scheduled 300 ms ahead and paid-song starts further ahead. cineTime() is canonical show seconds; trackTime() is seconds on the selected audio track.
tracks.js deals built-ins by seed modulo four (zero/missing uses fromage); trackOf(c) prefers c.track when it has music. Preserve source-track time versus canonical scene-clock distinction.

Paid own-track metadata is carried in shared c.track from the buyer's body state; anchors map start, drop/vision windows and end onto canonical time, while BPM, firstBeat and bars remain source-track values.

Track kick runs are converted to canonical seconds before stage propagation; shader params ta1..ta4 and tdur must match tracks.js, with fb/bps retaining track beat. Idle materials receive IDENTITY params.
score.yml remains the canonical show/deck and vision-slot timeline regardless of selected audio duration or BPM; all 36 registry entries are built:true and dealVisions filters by built.

scripts/lib/trip.js sector masks are sliced around the stage axis (x=0, y=15, along Z) and by depth; seam transitions spread over about five seconds. vision-eye-pyramid/flower-of-life backdrops close inward; sky-whale/scarab fields fray below their crests, while hummingbird, merkaba, time-keeper and sri-yantra motifs arrive in slower bands, stars or beads.
